text: Reputation based market dynamics lower the cost of duplication relative to centralized micro task work: where a reliable high reputation worker completes the task, duplication can fall from fifteen to five or fewer in a decentralized setup, which is what enables scaling of micro task work.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4755632
